question: Is PDFIndi free to use?
answer:
Yes, PDFIndi is 100% free! All our PDF tools and utility tools are completely free to use with:

  • ✅No registration required - Use all tools without creating an account
  • ✅No hidden charges - Absolutely free, forever
  • ✅No premium features - Everything is accessible to everyone
  • ✅No file limits - Process as many files as you need
  • ✅No watermarks - Your output files are clean and professional

Our mission is to provide accessible, high-quality PDF tools to everyone in India and worldwide, supporting the Atmanirbhar Bharat vision of self-reliant technology.
